# dspc_file_storage (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing file storage volume from the DSPC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dspc_file_storage" "example" {
  name = "my-file-storage"
}

output "file_storage_size" {
  description = "The size of the file storage."
  value       = data.dspc_file_storage.example.size
}

output "file_storage_nfs_mount_path" {
  description = "The NFS mount path for the file storage."
  value       = data.dspc_file_storage.example.nfs_mount_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the file storage.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the file storage (same as name).
- `nfs_mount_path` (String) NFS path used to mount the file storage.
- `size` (String) Size of the file storage (e.g. 100Gi).
- `status` (String) Current status of the file storage.
